title: Every n-covector on ℝ^{n+1} is the determinant with first column φ_β
statement: Let n ≥ 0 and let β be an n-covector on ℝ^{n+1} (a continuous alternating n-linear form). Let e_0, …, e_n be the standard basis of ℝ^{n+1}, j.succAbove the increasing enumeration of {0, …, n} ∖ {j}, b_j := β(e_{j.succAbove 0}, …, e_{j.succAbove(n−1)}) for j ∈ {0, …, n}, and φ_β := Σ_{j=0}^{n} (−1)^j b_j e_j. For x ∈ ℝ^{n+1} and a = (a_0, …, a_{n−1}) in ℝ^{n+1}, let [x, a] be the (n+1)×(n+1) real matrix whose column 0 is x and whose column l+1 is a_l (its entry in row r, column c is the r-th coordinate of the c-th column vector). Then β(a_0, …, a_{n−1}) = det[φ_β, a] for every a = (a_0, …, a_{n−1}) ∈ (ℝ^{n+1})^n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (β : Covector (Euclid (n + 1)) n) (a : Fin n → Euclid (n + 1)), β a = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun r c : Fin (n + 1) => (Fin.cons (∑ j : Fin (n + 1), ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (j : ℕ) * β (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (j.succAbove k) (1 : ℝ))) • EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) a : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)) c r)
